key_insight: Detonation-spray parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: Selecting nozzle traverse speed and spray distance offers a route to controlling coating geometry and maximizing water repellency.
method: Evaluate coating surface properties under varied detonation-spray conditions.
Relate roughness and thickness to nozzle traverse speed using inverse power laws.
Relate roughness and contact angle to spray distance using parabolic equations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports parameter-dependent trends and optimal conditions for maximum hydrophobicity, but provides no numerical results or fit-quality metrics.
watch_item: Validate the reported equations within the intended equipment and operating range before using them for process optimization.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
